name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for go-karting at a local track near Shanghai. He quickly realized that his passion lay not just in driving, but in understanding the intricate mechanics and data behind performance. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, Li sought opportunities to combine his technical knowledge with his love for racing. He started as a data analyst for a small racing team, meticulously studying telemetry and driver feedback to optimize car setups. 

Driven by a strong desire to lead and coordinate, Li transitioned into the role of a test driver coordinator. He excels in bridging the gap between drivers and engineers, ensuring seamless communication and efficient testing procedures. Li's approach is characterized by his meticulous attention to detail, his ability to adapt to rapidly changing situations, and his unwavering commitment to continuous improvement. He's always seeking innovative ways to streamline testing processes and maximize the value of every test session.

What sets Li apart is his proactive approach to problem-solving. He doesn't just identify issues; he actively seeks out solutions, collaborating with engineers and drivers to implement improvements on the fly. His ambition is to one day lead a top-tier Formula 1 testing program, contributing to the development of world-championship-winning cars.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Li has a lean build and a focused expression, often seen with a tablet in hand.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations during test sessions.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when concentrating.
Insists on starting every test session with a team huddle and a shared cup of green tea.
